summary.vi: nhóm dữ liệu, tổng hợp theo nhóm, lọc nhóm với HAVING
summary.en: grouping data, per-group aggregates, filtering groups with HAVING

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM customers
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY num_customers DESC;

prompt.vi: Đếm số khách hàng theo từng city: trả về hai cột (city, số lượng).
prompt.en: Count customers per city: return two columns (city, count).

hint.vi: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city;
hint.en: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city;

prompt.vi: Liệt kê các category có nhiều hơn 2 sản phẩm (dùng HAVING), kèm số lượng.
prompt.en: List the categories with more than 2 products (use HAVING), with the count.

hint.vi: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
hint.en: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY category;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
